decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app extends the firm's core dental practice software knowledge, is presented as its flagship new product line, and its own R&D lets it interpret early feedback and improve the app.

The continuing education institute draws on the firm's long-standing training content and practitioner relationships, so the firm can assimilate learner feedback, and the institute strengthens customer ties at modest cost.
The remote screen-sharing support tool sits within the firm's existing customer support competence, is cheap to maintain, and directly supports service efficiency for its practice customers.
